item.description: Meyer Shank Racing ace Felix Rosenqvist joins RACER Weekly to set the scene on 2026 and give us his goals for the season ahead – starting with putting MSR in the win column. Plus, RACER editor David Malsher rates the title contenders and talks rookie class star power.

item.title: Motorsport boss Isola to leave Pirelli
item.description: Pirelli’s head of motorsport Mario Isola will leave the tire manufacturer in July, handing over duties to Dario Marrafuschi.

item.title: IndyCar IOB chairman Nair lays out plans to revamp series' rulebook and tech procedures
item.description: IndyCar Officiating Board chairman Raj Nair says the IOB intends to complete a sweeping revision to IndyCar’s rulebook to eliminate oversights and confusion, which he cited as a factor in some of the rule violations that took place in recent seasons.

item.title: Netflix set to show Canadian GP as Apple TV carries Drive to Survive
item.description: Netflix will broadcast this year’s Canadian Grand Prix as a result of a partnership that will also include Apple TV carrying the latest season of the streaming giant's Formula 1 docuseries.
